scope: National Assembly election of 22 March 2026, all 90 seats: every list of candidates with national votes, printed percentages and seats (88), and the Italian and Hungarian national-community elections (one seat each) with candidate votes and elected status (without names), with entitled voters, voters who voted, ballots cast, valid and invalid ballots, from the National Electoral Commission's minutes establishing the result (Uradni list RS 197/2026), cross-checked against the commission's result data file. Earlier elections, constituency and district results, candidate names and personal data, party attribution and the indirectly elected National Council are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner brief "Complete ten-country parliamentary election coverage and historical institutional integration" (Croatia, Slovenia, Romania, Austria), naming www.izbori.hr and www.dvk-rs.si as official sources.
Owner answer "Accept for all four": publication on the reading of each copyright act's official-texts provision, national and constituency figures only, no candidate names.
Owner answer "Register both": www.dvk-rs.si and www.izbori.hr registered for manual reading only (exact files and pages, one request each, no crawling).

reuse_right.basis: ZASP Art. 9(1)(2): official texts from the legislative, administrative and judicial fields are not protected (read 2026-11-18 on PISRS) — the owner's reading for the commission's minutes published in the official gazette. Weaker than a licence.

normalized_republication.basis: National figures only (voters, ballots, list votes and seats; national-community candidate votes without names) transcribed from the minutes; attribution to the National Electoral Commission and Uradni list RS.

raw_redistribution.basis: The minutes (which also print the 90 elected members' names, dates of birth and addresses) are identified by checksum and not committed; no personal data is transcribed. The commission's data files are kept in local-evidence/ by checksum.

acquisition_route.basis: pisrs.si already registered (manual); the minutes PDF linked from the commission's page was read once in the visible browser pane (curl receives HTTP 407) and its text decoded in the page. www.dvk-rs.si registered (robots.txt read); the archive's documented result files rezultati.json and udelezba.json were downloaded once each. Test files on the commission's page (built from partial 2022 data) were identified and not used.

source_files_complete.basis: The minutes print entitled voters, voters who voted, ballots, invalid and valid ballots, every list with votes and percentage, the lists taking part, the quotient sequence and seats per list, and both national-community elections; all figures are transcribed.

national_definition_complete.basis: List votes equal valid ballots; valid plus invalid equal ballots cast; printed turnout and percentages reproduce (rounded); lists at or above 4% equal the seven named; D'Hondt over 88 seats reproduces the seats; each community's candidate votes equal valid ballots and the elected candidate has most votes; the commission's data file agrees on every list's votes and seats; seats total 90.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list keeps its row, the commission's list id and a name checksum; names containing a person are shown by the commission's published short name. No list is linked to a party or across elections.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: The minutes cite ZVDZ Arts. 90–93 and print the 4% threshold and the D'Hondt quotient sequence over 88 seats; the institutional registry record si-es-dz-constitutional holds the statute read from PISRS.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: The minutes (DVK 041-5/2025-26) were adopted on 7 April 2026 and published in Uradni list RS 197/2026.

continuity: None: no party register was reviewed; continuous_party_series is 0.
